preserved: Two independent 32-item producer and public-consumer channels; native bounded idle produces 66 chunks and collects 33.
First chunk observation starts before execution middleware and provider invocation, independent of public consumer polling.
Compact receipt precedes collector; raw text and deltas remain outside receipt events for Chat/Responses/Anthropic/unknown chunks.
Exactly one synchronous finalizer on exhaustion, source/collector error, explicit close or live-loop receiver drop; finalizer exceptions suppress their payload.
Owned original exception delivered to the public receiver; source cleanup failure retained across repeated closes; natural exhaustion does not call aclose again.
Null finalizer uses owned handle data fallback; sanitized response precedes response codec; known authoritative usage/finish upgrades early-close status only.
Unknown finish reason uses the native externally tagged JSON enum; malformed normalized-key collisions fail closed through event sanitizer return validation.
Reserved publication sequence and captured origin loop/context permit nonblocking termination with async response/end sanitizers while flush_async waits for END.
Lifecycle subscriber snapshot survives later registration/removal; removed profiles cannot leak through Event.annotated_response.
comparison_boundaries: Absolute timestamps and measured elapsed durations are scheduling-dependent; event presence, first-observation boundary, queue occupancy, numeric fields, finalizer counts, payloads and error messages are compared.

The common qualified request/intercept/stack/optimization/pricing engines remain separately owned. This unit does not claim the full dynamic native SDK or all arbitrary request/optimization schema mutations.
